title: "Spatial interpolation example"

---

## Description and motivation

**Lake Rangsdorf - bathymetry**

* Using multiple depth measurements obtained for Lake Rangsdorf, we apply IDW to estimate bathymetric profile (lake floor depth profile).  
* To show the process of combining data from different sources: checking data quality, merging datasets, filtering `sf` objects.  
* Plotting the results.  


*General description of the Rangsdorf lake and its location:*  

* Lake Rangsdorf is located at the southern margin of the Teltow Plateau and a former proglacial drainage system, the Rangsdorf-Thyrow-Abflussbahn. Its basin has originally emerged as part of a subglacial drainage system, still visible at the panhandle Krumme Lanke and its northern continuation–the Glasow-Bach valley, whereas the main basin has been designed as a kettle hole. The northern part of Krumme Lanke still exhibits its basin shape as a glacial tunnel lake (max. lake depth 9 m with and average depth of roughly 3.5 m), where the southern main lake shows the typical morphology of a kettle lake silting up to an average depth of approx. 0.9 m (max. 2.7 m). As most of the other shallow lakes in Brandenburg, lake Rangsdorf is an eutrophic to hypertrophic lake suffering from heavy algae blooms in summer season.



```{r, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,include=FALSE}
library(terra)
library(gstat)
library(mapview)
mapview::mapviewOptions(basemaps = "OpenStreetMap")
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
```

--- 

## First, we read-in the three datasets

* **The first dataset is a map of the lake (shore-line):**

```{r,message=FALSE}
shoreline <- st_read('data/lake.gpkg')
str(shoreline)
st_crs(shoreline)$epsg # https://epsg.io/32633 coords in meters, dist. from "centerpoint"
plot(shoreline[,1])
```


* **Second dataset is a series of geo-coded sonar depth measurements**

```{r}
sonar <- st_read('data/sonar.gpkg')
str(sonar)
plot(sonar[,1])
```


* **Third dataset comes from geo-coded sediment-sampling records**

```{r}
sediments <- read.csv("data/Sediments.csv")
str(sediments)
#
sediments <- st_as_sf(sediments,
                      coords = c('x', 'y'), 
                      crs = 32633,
                      sf_column_name="geom") # to match remaining datasets
plot(sediments[,"depth_m"])
```

--- 

## Data visualization 

* Using the `{mapview}` package, the three datasets can be visualized on a map:

```{r}
mapview(shoreline, color = "red", highlight = F, label = 'Shoreline') + 
  mapview(sonar, color = 'black', highlight = F, label = 'Sonar', cex = 1) + 
  mapview(sediments, label = 'Sediment \ndata', cex = 4)

# Alternative, sf-based visualization
plot(st_geometry(shoreline), col = "lightblue", main = "Shoreline")
plot(st_geometry(sonar), add = TRUE, pch = 16, cex = 0.25, col = "black")
plot(st_geometry(sediments), add = TRUE, pch = 16, cex = 0.8, col = "red")
legend(
  "bottomleft",
  legend = c("shoreline", "sonar", "sediments"),
  col = c("lightblue", "black", "red"),
  pch = c(15, 16, 16),
  bty = "n")

```


---- 

## Bathymetric profile: step-by-step analysis

#### (1) Extract shoreline data features

Note that `shoreline` object is a single polygon (line along the shore). However, you can safely assume that the depth at shore is zero and use the data for interpolation (zero-depth at shore assumption holds for our lake, not in general).  

```{r shoreline}
# cast polygon to line and create point 30 m apart (approx.)
shoreline_line <- st_cast(st_boundary(shoreline), "LINESTRING")
st_length(shoreline_line)

shoreline_points <- st_line_sample(shoreline_line, density = 1 / 30) |> 
  # density (points per distance unit) 
  st_cast("POINT") |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  st_set_crs(st_crs(shoreline)) |>
  mutate(depth_m = 0)
```

#### (2) Basic data cleaning and verfication

Are all geocodings compatible (EPSG-codes identical)? Are all measurements valid (say, "inside" the lake polygon)? Are there any NA depth measurements? Are there any sonar-based zero measurements? While shoreline zero-depth is OK, sonar-based zero measurements are errors (based on additional device-related information).

```{r verify}
# CRS settings are OK in this example

# data inside polygon
sonar_in <- st_filter(sonar, shoreline)
sediments_in <- st_filter(sediments, shoreline)

# remove errors from data
sonar_clean <- sonar_in |>
  filter(!is.na(depth_m), depth_m > 0)

sediments_clean <- sediments_in |>
  filter(!is.na(depth_m), depth_m >= 0)

# fix geometry names
st_geometry(shoreline_points) <- "geometry"
st_geometry(sonar_clean) <- "geometry"
st_geometry(sediments_clean) <- "geometry"

# join the datasets
# combine datasets
bathymetry_pts <- shoreline_points %>% 
  dplyr::select(depth_m) %>% 
  rbind(sonar_clean[,"depth_m"]) %>% 
  rbind(sediments_clean[,"depth_m"])

# depth as negative numbers
bathymetry_pts$depth_m <- bathymetry_pts$depth_m*-1
```


#### (3) Descriptive statistics


```{r geostatistics, warning=FALSE}
# summary
summary(bathymetry_pts$depth_m)

# semivariogram
emp_variogram <- variogram(depth_m ~ 1, bathymetry_pts)
vgm_model <- fit.variogram(emp_variogram,
                           model = vgm(psill = 2, model = "Sph", 
                                       range = 600, nugget = 0.1))
plot(emp_variogram,vgm_model)
```



#### (4) Generate a target object for interpolation

```{r grid}
bbox <- st_bbox(shoreline)
bbox_sf <- st_as_sfc(bbox)

grid <- st_make_grid(bbox_sf, cellsize = 20, what = "centers") |>
  st_as_sf()

grid <- st_filter(grid, shoreline)
grid$depth_m <- NA_real_

plot(st_geometry(shoreline), col = "lightblue", main = "Interpolation grid")
plot(st_geometry(grid), add = TRUE, pch = 16, cex = 0.25, col = "darkgreen")
```



#### (5) IDW


```{r idw}
idw_model <- gstat(formula = depth_m ~ 1, locations = bathymetry_pts, 
                   set = list(idp = 2))
idw_result <- predict(idw_model, newdata = grid)

plot(idw_result["var1.pred"], main = "IDW interpolation - 2D")
plot(st_geometry(shoreline), add = TRUE)

# 3D plot using terra-based raster
idw_vect <- terra::vect(idw_result)
idw_r_template <- terra::rast(idw_vect, res = 25)
idw_raster <- terra::rasterize(idw_vect, idw_r_template, field = "var1.pred")
plot(idw_raster, main = "IDW raster")
lines(vect(shoreline), col = "black")

idw_matrix <- rayshader::raster_to_matrix(idw_raster)
idw_matrix_plot <- idw_matrix
idw_matrix_plot[is.na(idw_matrix_plot)] <- 0

plot_ly(
  type = "surface",
  z = idw_matrix_plot,
  contours = list(
    z = list(show = TRUE, size = 1, color = "white")
  )
) |>
  layout(
    title = "IDW - 3D bathymetry",
    scene = list(
      zaxis = list(title = "Depth [m]"),
      xaxis = list(title = "X"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Y"),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.2, y = -1.2, z = 0.7)),
      aspectratio = list(x = 1, y = 1, z = 0.3)
    )
  )
```

*Example amended from: Hartmann, K., Krois, J., Waske, B. (2018): E-Learning Project SOGA: Statistics and Geospatial Data Analysis. Department of Earth Sciences, Freie Universitaet Berlin.*
